fresh_freehire_directory.caveat: Mutable paged directory, not an atomic provider export; targeted current identity queries also required.

notes: Maintainer explicitly requested and authorized publication; no auto-merge.
All recipes executed through the canonical exported runtime, with independent complete listing-ID and language comparisons.
These are entire named employer boards; other worldwide sources are not silently claimed.
Food Process Solutions was excluded because FreeHire already publishes the exact ApplicantStack source.
Adamson was held back because supported extraction produced no full descriptions, despite complete listings and verified Canadian/US offices. No partial-description scraper is included.
DSD was held back because a separately advertised opportunity inventory requires an additional source.
The full source descriptions and source ownership were checked for every observed posting.
